redesign.name: 全屏机房.png
redesign.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen 16:9 game background, desired 1280x720. A spacious futuristic military base supercomputer room, rows of navy GPU server racks at the far left and far right, muted cyan status lights, cables in ceiling, restrained amber utility lamps, a dark blue floor reflecting subtle light. Polished 2D illustrated cartoon game art with bold outlines and shaded metallic forms matching a chibi extraction shooter. Large low-contrast quiet area across center for live interface overlays, room architecture not a panel. Entire image bleeds to all four edges. No decorative outer frame, no border, no sidebar, no buttons, no labels or text, no characters, no graphs, no watermark. Keep the room readable but darker behind white text.

defaults.firstProduction: Timer starts on first opening the matrix; 24h with 0 GPUs, 4h with 20 GPUs.
defaults.gpuInstallation: Move GPU from warehouse into chosen slot after confirmation; click installed slot to return to warehouse, with overflow mail fallback. Retain completed cycle fraction when installing or removing.
defaults.market: Local calendar day. Deterministic virtual daily OHLC, fixed daily buy/sell quote, 120000–320000 configurable, 5 purchases daily.
